title: Quarantine entry (external-effect release gate)
$comment: Structural residue of the effect.* rules (P0-5). One atomically persisted entry per received delivery (effect.quarantine.atomic-entry): the exact wire variant, the payload bytes' digest, the delivery metadata, and the sink profile the entry was admitted under. The entry is the custody chain between evaluation and effect — a ReleaseAuthorization is matched against these exact bytes, never against a re-fetch (effect.release.exact-bytes). State lives in the effect-status record (effect-status.json), keyed by quarantineEntryId; the entry itself is immutable once committed. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

quarantineEntryId.$comment: Unique within the sink instance; referenced by ReleaseAuthorization, effect-status, and receipts.

payloadDigest.$comment: Digest of the exact payload bytes AND the content address of the payload blob persisted in the same atomic commit as this record (effect.quarantine.atomic-entry): the bytes are part of the entry, not a by-reference fetch target, and a record whose blob is missing is a torn entry, never treated as admitted. Payload binding is a structural pregate (effect.quarantine.structural-pregate): an entry exists only for a payload that already matched its credential binding.

payloadSizeBytes.$comment: Byte count in the string domain (canon.number.safe-integer); input to quota accounting (effect.quarantine.capacity).

deliveryMetadata.$comment: Where and when the delivery arrived; the occurrence discriminator feeds the delivery identity (effect.delivery.identity).

deliveryOccurrence.$comment: Distinguishes repeated legitimate deliveries of the same variant to the same sink.

sourcePrincipal.$comment: Admission principal for per-principal quota accounting (effect.quarantine.capacity).

decimalString.$comment: canon.number.safe-integer: a non-negative count in the string domain, not a JSON number.

sinkProfileId.$comment: effect.sink.classification. legacy-adjacent-write@1 is a migration posture only (effect.migration.exclusive-writers); it never issues effect contracts. Kept in sync with scope-catalog.json.
